description: Adds some text to the current paragraph.

params.description: The text that we want to insert into the current document element. It can be a string or an array of Unicode code points.
params.name: text

params.description: An array of character widths (in millimeters). It should be the same length as the array of code points passed in the "text" parameter. When the widths are specified, the characters are added preserving these exact widths.
params.name: widths

signature: AddText(text: string | number[], widths?: number[]): ApiRun
